judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: This has Westwood's fingerprints: inconsistent capitals (Urchins/urchins, East, Adventurer), stiff phrasing like 'located East of here', a mayor's mild exclamations, and a hand-off to the Captain at the gates with advice to buy supplies first. It matches the opening of a Nox town chapter almost exactly.
